_about: N,N-Dimethylformamide (1) + Dimethyl sulfoxide (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n,n-dimethylformamide, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n,n-dimethylformamide, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Zhang, X.[Xuemei], Liu, H.[Hongpeng], Yang, W.[Wei], Jian, C.[Chungui], Miao, Y.[Yanfeng], Experimental isobaric (vapor + liquid) equilibrium data for the binary system N, N-dimethyl formamide + dimethyl sulfoxide and the quaternary system sec-butyl alcohol + sec-butyl acetate + N, Ndimethyl formamide + dimethyl sulfoxide at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 409 (2016) 78-83
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0089. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
